G2_geometry.mechanism: CCW orientation traverses a shared edge in opposite senses; direction vectors cancel exactly; interior walls drop from the boundary

G1_inside_bare_T1.reading: all three additive-log constructions are exact metrics inside one bare triangle; boundary evaluation diverges on every ladder (the ln(1/x) law)

G2_welded_metrics.reading: on the welded convex union, the Hilbert cross-ratio is a metric across all three cells simultaneously (classic convex-domain result, reproduced); the log-barrier l2 is a norm-of-coordinate-difference and is a metric by structure

tangency_finding.reading: EXACT tangency puts the transfer point ON both boundaries: the Klein/log distance to it is +infinity (machine: inf), so a finite 'welded-disk' number at exact tangency is not reproducible under the log family — welding requires a delta-interior transfer (finite edge correlation K > 0). With the delta-transfer, cross-cell triangle inequality is an EXACT INHERITANCE: d13 = d1(p1,A12) + d2(B12,A23) + d3(B23,p3) <= d1 + [d2(B12,p2)+d2(p2,A23)] + d3 = d12 + d23 reduces to the per-cell metricity; the transfer cost diverges like ln(1/delta) as delta -> 0 (ladder above).

G3_isotropy.reading_G3: the circle buys ROTATIONAL ISOTROPY: 1A/1C are anisotropic at the centroid (hexagonal unit balls); 1B is isotropic at the single-cell centroid but the GLUED barrier inherits the trapezoid's global shape (anisotropy above); the inscribed-disk Klein metric is exactly isotropic (spread 0 to machine precision) and stays isotropic under gluing

G4_dimension_sweep.reading: C(D,2) = D holds ONLY at D = 3 among 1,2,3,4,5,7; the octonion route (D = 7) fails associativity by machine witness (associator = 2 on the Fano triples, e.g. (e1 e2) e4 = +e7 while e1 (e2 e4) = -e7). Geometry alone (directed simplices + inscribed spheres + log metrics) exists in EVERY dimension; the algebraic direction closure (Theorem II.1) is what selects D = 3 uniquely.
